name: Ur
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Ur was the father of Elale and a descendant of Judah through the lineage of Hur. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of the tribe of Judah. Little is known about his life beyond his place in the family line.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Ur is listed in the genealogies of Chronicles as the son of Hur and father of Elale, part of the family line of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of Hur
keyEvents.description: Ur belonged to the lineage of Hur, who was the son of Caleb and Ephrathah, and who was an important figure in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Bezalel
keyEvents.description: Through his father Hur, Ur is connected to Bezalel, the skilled craftsman who built the tabernacle, since Bezalel was also a son of Ur and a grandson of Hur.

keyEvents.title: Bezalel's Appointment as Craftsman
keyEvents.description: Bezalel, son of Uri and grandson of Hur of the tribe of Judah, was chosen by God and filled with wisdom and knowledge to lead the construction of the tabernacle.
